clips.title: Jason's Past REVEALED 😳 Then Lucia Calls… | GTA 6 Launch Trailer
clips.description: The GTA 6 launch trailer opens with Jason admitting he "got in some trouble in the army" and that nobody gives loans to people like him. He's polishing boats at a marina when the phone rings: a free call from Lucia Caminos. This is where it all starts.

clips.title: Vice City Has NEVER Looked This Good 🌴 GTA 6
clips.description: The music kicks in and Vice City lights up: the skyline at night, a crew in a green convertible, an iguana under the overpass and a pink-and-orange sunset over the water. Eleven seconds that show why everyone is waiting for November 19.

clips.title: The GTA 6 Heist Crew Goes ALL IN 💰 (Vault Scene)
clips.description: Tactical gear in the swamp at sunset, brass knuckles, a night jump out of a helicopter, an airboat through the marsh — and then two silhouettes walking through a giant vault door with paper flying everywhere. The heists in GTA 6 look huge.

clips.title: Jason & Lucia: Partners in Crime ❤️‍🔥 GTA 6
clips.description: A quiet sunset in an apartment over the ocean, a packed neon club, a truck racing under an airplane wing, and the two of them side by side in a container yard. Love story or crime story? In GTA 6 it's both.

clips.title: Vice City After Dark Is WILD 🪩 GTA 6 Launch Trailer
clips.description: A bar fight, a tense moment against a tiled wall, two performers on stage under pink lights and a red sports car tearing through the city at night. Vice City nightlife looks dangerous in the best way.

clips.title: GTA 6 Stunts Look INSANE 🏍️ Wheelies, Huge Jumps & Cops
clips.description: Police sirens through the palm trees, a dirt bike wheelie across a bridge, a massive jump into the sky and a motorcycle cutting through a dark alley. The bikes in GTA 6 are going to be a lot of fun.

clips.title: From Ankle Monitor to Pure CHAOS 💥 GTA 6
clips.description: A blinking ankle monitor, a rooftop explosion over the skyline, a full-auto shootout — and a wing walker on a biplane trailing red smoke over a crowded beach. Eight seconds, zero calm.

clips.title: The Wildest Characters in GTA 6 🐍 Gold Guns & Pink Masks
clips.description: A tattooed giant in the gym, a guy relaxing with a huge snake, and two women in pink balaclavas holding gold rifles — then another explosion lights up the street. Vice City is full of characters you won't forget.

clips.title: "Are We Gonna Be Okay?" 💔 GTA 6's Most Emotional Moment
clips.description: "Are we gonna be okay?" — "We've stuck together through everything. We've just gotta get through this." In the middle of all the chaos, the launch trailer slows down for Jason and Lucia on a balcony at sunset.

clips.title: GTA 6 Launch Trailer ENDING 🔥 November 19, 2026
clips.description: Crashing through a skyscraper window, hanging from a helicopter over the city, a police chase, a sniper scope — and a fall into a neon pool before the words everyone waited years for: Grand Theft Auto VI, November 19, 2026.
